dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete expert thresholds (30% NOT_ASSESSED, 60% PASS, 25% FAIL, 7‑day delegation stall) and detailed per‑account × region verification loops that a generic model would not know. Misses a subtle requirement: Config delivery channel must also be enabled, which is a known operational nuance.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes an AWS‑specific audit mindset: pre‑flight account status, pagination contracts, step‑wise worst‑verdict aggregation, and exact CLI remediation order. Could be tighter on the exact sequence of API calls (e.g., list‑assessments → get‑assessment → data‑source checks) but overall very procedure‑driven.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Provides an extensive NEVER list with concrete reasoning (e.g., never report LOW_COMPLIANCE when NOT_ASSESSED >30%, never trust INACTIVE scores, never ignore failed delegations) and explains the operational impact of each anti‑pattern.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description clearly states WHAT it does, WHEN to invoke, and includes a rich keyword list and activation triggers. The only minor gap is the absence of an explicit version‑compatibility matrix for different AWS CLI versions.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Top‑level Quick Start gives concise verdict rules; deeper sections (Mindset, Process, Anti‑Patterns) are revealed on demand. The Quick Start still packs many thresholds, which could cause slight cognitive overload, but overall layering is effective.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated with single and double CONFIRM prompts, throttling retries are limited, and classification is deterministic. Calibration matches task fragility well; only minor over‑constraint is the fixed 24‑hour warm‑up exemption rule, which may be too rigid for some environments.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Quick Start → Critical NEVERs → Mindset → Pre‑flight → Process → Anti‑Patterns → Reference). Section headings are consistent, aiding comprehension. Slightly ad‑hoc naming of some sections (e.g., "Step 0b") prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a full decision tree, concrete CLI commands, error‑handling flows, pagination loops, and output schema. Missing explicit example of handling partial pagination failures or unverified account‑region combos in the main flow, but an agent could still execute the skill successfully.
